metricExplanations.soilTemp: The modelled soil temperature at about 6 cm depth is averaged over today and the next two days.
metricExplanations.topsoil: The moisture gauge is a model estimate from three shallow soil layers. It is not a field measurement.
metricExplanations.rain: Rain totals add daily model estimates. Missing readings are not counted as zero.
metricExplanations.dryGap: A dry day has less than 1 mm rain. A missing rain reading is treated as unknown.
metricExplanations.waterBalance: This is forecast rain minus reference evapotranspiration (ET₀), not a direct measure of water in the field.
metricExplanations.heat: Counts forecast days with maximum temperature above the crop's illustrative heat-stress guide.
metricExplanations.heavyRain: Very heavy rain may move seed and fertiliser. Local drainage and soil conditions matter.
metricExplanations.harvest: Harvest timing varies by variety and growing conditions; this date is only an estimate.

howText: Mvula checks recent rain, the next few weeks of rain, and modelled soil conditions against simple crop rules. Weather and soil estimates can be wrong.
disclaimer: This is decision support, not a guarantee. Check local conditions and ask your extension officer before planting.
noSoil: Soil model data is not available here.
